chunks: And from him, from 'Ubayd Allah ibn Nahik, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Salamah, the companion of Al-Saburi, from Abi Al-Subah Al-Kinani, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is a grave near you to which no anguished person goes without Allah removing his anguish and fulfilling his request. And verily, next to it are four thousand angels since the day his life was taken, disheveled and covered with dust, weeping over him until the Day of Judgment. So whoever visits him, they escort him to his place of safety; and whoever is ill, they visit him; and whoever dies, they follow his funeral procession.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits and angelic accompaniments of visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith highlights the intercessory power of Imam Al-Husayn’s (a.s.) grave, emphasizing that the presence of four thousand angels weeping since his martyrdom serves as a perpetual spiritual witness. It underscores the practical Shia belief in *ziyarat* as a means of divine relief, where angels actively escort visitors to safety, visit the ill, and follow the deceased, linking physical pilgrimage to cosmic spiritual support.
